description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Excise Notification No. 988 - Order to declare that an excise duty be imposed and charged on Ethyl Alcohol w.e.f. 01.04.2016
categorisation: This gazette notification primarily concerns the establishment of new excise duty rules and import procedures for ethyl alcohol under the Excise Ordinance. It contains regulatory frameworks, compliance requirements, and statutory instruments related to taxation and import controls, which falls under Legal/Regulatory matters. While it mentions Minister Ravi Karunanayake, it does not describe his detailed portfolio responsibilities beyond his title as Minister of Finance, and the core content is regulatory rather than about government personnel or structure.
